title: auspol forecast pipeline
about: What the daily Victorian (and NSW 2027) forecast run does on GitHub Actions, in order, and how long each part takes: from fetching the polls to the forecast and the what-if sliders landing on the release and the data store the site reads. The model's own stages (the forecast's four steps and the rebuild's eight) are described in docs/PIPELINE.md; this file is the GitHub Actions run that executes them every day.

pipelines.name: Daily forecast refresh
pipelines.about: One run per day. The forecast job publishes first; then 16 what-if jobs (4 parties, 2 modes, 2 elections) rerun the seat model with one party's vote forced, side by side, and a last job combines and publishes them. Only full daily runs are counted: the title must say "(daily)" and the what-if jobs must have run. From 25 Nov 2026 every run uses 100,000 simulations (was 20,000), so runs before that date are faster than today's.
pipelines.triggers: The inthegame-blog site's worker dispatches it at 4:30am Melbourne time with daily=true; GitHub's own schedule (17:37 UTC) is a late fallback that the gate job skips when the day's run already went. It starts nothing else: the site reads the files it publishes.

jobs.name: gate
jobs.about: Checks whether today's daily forecast already ran, so a late fallback or a duplicated dispatch does not run it twice

steps.about: GitHub starts the machine and downloads the actions this job uses

steps.name: Run go() { echo "run=$1" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; }
steps.about: Lists the last 10 runs of this workflow and stops this one if a daily run in the last 12 hours already succeeded or is still going

steps.name: Complete job
steps.about: GitHub closes the job and cleans up the machine

jobs.name: refresh
jobs.about: The forecast itself: fetches the polls and the trained models, runs every model stage, and publishes Victoria and then NSW 2027 to the release and the data store

steps.name: Set up job
steps.about: GitHub starts the machine and downloads the actions this job uses

steps.name: Run actions/checkout@v4
steps.about: Downloads this repo's code onto the machine

steps.name: Run r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
steps.about: Installs R

steps.name: Run r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
steps.about: Installs the R packages this repo needs (from a cache when it can)

steps.name: Fetch the anchor's poll data
steps.about: Clones the poll CSVs and seat files from the aus-polling-analyser repository (a shallow copy of its analysis folder only)

steps.name: Restore cached election results
steps.about: Restores the past election results (VEC, ECSA, ECQ pages) saved by an earlier run; they never change, so they are fetched only when the fetch scripts change

steps.name: Fetch the trained models
steps.about: Downloads the trained trees and the fitted tables from the shipped-models release; refetches today's Wikipedia and Poll Bludger poll tables and leader ratings; fails if any required file is missing or the models are more than 14 days old

steps.name: Refuse zero-byte inputs
steps.about: Stops the run if any poll file, election result or downloaded model is an empty file

steps.name: Run the pipeline
steps.about: Runs scripts/run_all.R: every model stage from preference flows to the seat simulation and the pages (stages in the next table); then checks the Victorian outputs were written by this run

steps.name: Summarise
steps.about: Writes the headline numbers, every check line and the warnings to the run's summary page

steps.name: Publish the forecast to the forecast-latest release
steps.about: Uploads the Victorian forecast files and a poll snapshot to the forecast-latest release, then builds the all-primaries what-if simulations and the upper-house forecast

steps.name: Publish the forecast to R2 for the ITG page
steps.about: Copies the forecast, page data, what-if, upper-house, pollster and party files to the R2 store the site reads

steps.name: Keep a dated copy of the forecast on R2 (as-at history)
steps.about: Saves today's forecast under a dated name on R2, so past days can be shown (scripts/publish_forecast_history.sh)

steps.name: NSW 2027 forecast (on while the repository variable AUSPOL_PUBLISH_NSW2027 is 1, set 8 Oct)
steps.about: Downloads the NSW tables, runs the seat model for NSW 2027 at 20,000 simulations, builds its forecast JSON and poll-trend data, and uploads them to the release

steps.name: Publish the NSW 2027 forecast to R2 for the ITG page
steps.about: Copies the NSW 2027 forecast files to R2

steps.name: Keep a dated copy of the NSW 2027 forecast on R2 (as-at history)
steps.about: Saves today's NSW 2027 forecast under a dated name on R2

steps.name: Upload outputs
steps.about: Keeps the page, page data, projection mix and the run log as a downloadable bundle for 30 days

steps.name: Hand the scenario jobs their inputs
steps.about: Saves everything this job fetched and built so the 16 what-if jobs can start from it

steps.name: Raise an alarm
steps.about: On a daily run, opens or updates one tracking issue when a check fails with something new; otherwise writes "Alarm not raised"

steps.about: Clean-up for an earlier step (saves caches, removes credentials)

steps.name: Post Run actions/checkout@v4
steps.about: Clean-up for an earlier step (saves caches, removes credentials)

steps.name: Complete job
steps.about: GitHub closes the job and cleans up the machine
